description: Complete reusable Node/Web composition workflows. Runtime implementation is in franken_engine. Run scripts/project_compat_runner.py --corpus fixtures/compatibility/projects/stream-compose.corpus.json with actual --bin, --node and --bun executables; host/reference checks alone are not native compatibility proof.

cases.description: A CommonJS package exports a reusable chain of Web transforms with object-valued interior stages and a final flush, consumed by a Node file pipeline.
A conditional ESM package composes incremental Web text codecs and a text transform; one-byte Node file reads preserve Unicode through the reusable chain.

files.main.mjs: import make from '@fixture/text';import fs from 'node:fs';import {pipeline} from 'node:stream/promises';await pipeline(fs.createReadStream('input.txt',{highWaterMark:1}),make(),fs.createWriteStream('output.txt'));fs.writeFileSync('receipt.txt','complete\n');console.log('ESM_COMPOSE_FILE_COMPLETE');
files.node_modules/@fixture/text/index.mjs: import {compose} from 'node:stream';import {TextDecoderStream,TransformStream,TextEncoderStream} from 'node:stream/web';export default function(){return compose(new TextDecoderStream(),new TransformStream({transform(value,c){c.enqueue(value.toUpperCase());}}),new TextEncoderStream());}

cases.description: Readable.from values use the instance composition operator with a Web transform returned across a CommonJS module boundary, then flow to a file sink.
A writable-only composite preserves the Node head object mode and awaits a Web sink close that writes a separately checked completion file.
A reusable package transform fails after an independently acknowledged file write; pipeline rejection preserves the accepted bytes and does not run sink finalization.

files.main.cjs: const s=require('node:stream'),fs=require('fs');let acknowledge;const accepted=new Promise(resolve=>{acknowledge=resolve;});async function* source(){yield 'first';await accepted;yield 'bad';}fs.writeFileSync('output.txt','');const sink=new s.Writable({write(value,encoding,done){fs.appendFileSync('output.txt',value);acknowledge();done();},final(done){fs.writeFileSync('final.txt','unexpected\n');done();}});s.promises.pipeline(s.Readable.from(source()),require('./convert.cjs')(),sink).then(()=>console.log('UNEXPECTED_SUCCESS'),error=>{fs.writeFileSync('failed.txt',error.message+'\n');console.log('COMPOSE_FAILED',error.message);});
